title: Camelback Paradise
description:
Hamptons-Inspired Retreat with Resort-Style Amenities!

Escape to our stunning Grey Stone Manor, a breathtaking single-level home. Nestled in a picturesque setting, this property is perfect for families & friends! 

✨ Enjoy soaring 24 ft vaulted ceilings, & the comfort of every bedroom with walk-in closets. The master suite is a sanctuary featuring a marble bath with a steam shower, jetted tub! 

✨ Dive into relaxation with our state-of-the-art movie theatre, game room & a stunning wine room!
